create_bernoulli_game_sampler: create a BernoulliGameSampler with strategy spaces, mean payoffs, and payoff bounds for game simulation
get_game_for_sampler: get a pre-processed game sampler for ResponseGraphUCB examples given a game name like bernoulli or kuhn_poker
plot_timeseries: plot timeseries data with error bars on a matplotlib axis using mean and standard error
get_kuhn_poker_data: get kuhn poker metagame payoff tables for a specified number of players using fictitious play
get_method_acronym: get a pretty LaTeX acronym string for a ResponseGraphUCB method name for use in plot labels
